title: HostEventRosterInsightViewDocument
description: Server-owned manager projection of one event's roster insights, written ahead of time by triggers on the event, its attendees, the contact edges, contacts, traits and payments. rows holds what the retired getEventRosterInsights callable returned for each attendee (at most 1,000), except that top_catch_spender is never stored (the phone adds it from hostOrganizerSpendProjections) and member is always stored. Every label uses history from before cutoffAtMillis, the event's start, so later history cannot change it: a view is maintained until 24 hours after the event ends (its start when it has no end) and then frozen. A row that fails validation records sourceCoverage invalidSource and keeps the previous rows; nothing is thrown. Deleted when the event is deleted or loses its organizer. Managers get it under rules; authority comes from the organizer document, never from the view.
x-owner: Host roster insight evaluator (hostReadModels roster insight view triggers)

organizerId.description: The event's organizer; rules key on it.

cutoffAtMillis.description: The event's start. Attendance labels count only events that ended before it; Catch spend counts only payments completed at or before it.

revision.description: Increases by one with every committed evaluation that changed the document.

sourceCoverage.description: exact: every attendee has a row built from complete history. partial: more than 1,000 attendees, more than 10,000 history edges, a row still waiting for its contact projection, or a linked account with more payments than one evaluation reads. invalidSource: a source row failed validation, the previous rows kept.

incompleteSource.description: The collection behind partial or invalidSource coverage (eventAttendees, organizerContactEventEdges, organizerContacts, organizerContactTraits or payments), or null when coverage is exact.
